result.summary: Added one new evidence patch file, docs/validation/evidence/fishing-component-validation-2026-09-20/author-owner.patch, containing a single unified diff that appends the FISHING-S4-VALIDATE-R01 v1 / ADR0181 section-4 validation block to the end of godot/scripts/core/fishing.gd. The diff adds only: (a) the 16 exact REFUSE_COLUMN_* constants (SHAPE, FLAG, HABITAT_ENUM, HABITAT_VALUE, HABITAT_REF, HABITAT_FREE, HABITAT_STATE, STOCK_LINK, STOCK_FREE, STOCK_SPECIES, STOCK_VALUE, STOCK_STATE, SPECIES_DUPLICATE, QUOTA, SELF_DUPLICATE, ZONE_DUPLICATE) plus COLUMN_BLANK_SPECIES_ID; (b) class Columns with exactly the 22 typed packed columns in canonical ordinal order, 32-row habitat and 96-row stock extents, argument-free _init sizing with all-zero defaults except habitat_zone_slot/habitat_ref_slot/stock_habitat_slot/stock_species_id = -1, and is_sized(); (c) static columns_refusal(image) plus small static argument-only helpers. Order is exactly: null/22-extent shape before any indexing; global 5 flag columns in canonical field order (habitat_present, stock_present, habitat_intensive, stock_closed, stock_restocking) with ascending rows; ascending habitat rows (enum, then nonnegative pollution/protected_fraction and danger 0..3, then refs, then inactive-retained vs present state); ascending stock rows (presence link, blank inactive rows, parent self-reference equality, nonnegative species item id, source-table capacity/10%..K population/quota-bounded harvest, then strict cross-multiplied 100*P vs 30*K / 40*K hysteresis with independent stored closed); then per present habitat species-id distinctness followed by the shared harvested quota; then a self-SLOT duplicate pass and a separate nonnull zone SLOT+GENERATION pair pass. Source constants and the three compiled tables are indexed only after type/range gates; stock species ids are never used as table subscripts; existing EffortClaimColumns, section-7 schema 2, all existing writers and methods are untouched (pure additions after the file's final line). No live constructors, callbacks, diagnostics, input mutation, bulk API or float are introduced; the fixed 32-row nested duplicate scans allocate no packed scratch, keeping the conservative 10688-byte packed budget. The patch is 376 newline-separated lines in total (3 header lines, 4 context lines, 369 added lines), under the 550 hard limit. The hunk's old start line is a context-matched approximation and relies on the four unique trailing context lines of _refuse_claim_column.

files.content:
--- a/godot/scripts/core/fishing.gd
+++ b/godot/scripts/core/fishing.gd
@@ -2952,4 +2952,373 @@
 func _refuse_claim_column(code: StringName) -> bool:
 	"""Record one claim-column refusal and return false. Changes no other field."""
 	_last_claim_column_refusal = code
 	return false
+
+
+# --- FISHING-S4-VALIDATE-R01 v1: the cold section 4 column image ---------------------------------
+
+## ADR0181's section 4 codes. They are DISTINCT from every gameplay refusal above: a cold image
+## is refused by shape and stored relation, never by a live store's admission rules.
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_SHAPE: StringName = &"COLUMN_SHAPE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAG: StringName = &"COLUMN_FLAG"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_ENUM: StringName = &"COLUMN_HABITAT_ENUM"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_VALUE: StringName = &"COLUMN_HABITAT_VALUE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_REF: StringName = &"COLUMN_HABITAT_REF"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_FREE: StringName = &"COLUMN_HABITAT_FREE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_STATE: StringName = &"COLUMN_HABITAT_STATE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_LINK: StringName = &"COLUMN_STOCK_LINK"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_FREE: StringName = &"COLUMN_STOCK_FREE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_SPECIES: StringName = &"COLUMN_STOCK_SPECIES"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_VALUE: StringName = &"COLUMN_STOCK_VALUE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_STATE: StringName = &"COLUMN_STOCK_STATE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_SPECIES_DUPLICATE: StringName = &"COLUMN_SPECIES_DUPLICATE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_QUOTA: StringName = &"COLUMN_QUOTA"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_SELF_DUPLICATE: StringName = &"COLUMN_SELF_DUPLICATE"
+const REFUSE_COLUMN_ZONE_DUPLICATE: StringName = &"COLUMN_ZONE_DUPLICATE"
+
+## The blank a cleared stock row carries in its species column.
+const COLUMN_BLANK_SPECIES_ID: int = -1
+
+
+class Columns:
+	"""The cold section 4 image: 22 typed packed columns, 32 habitat rows and 96 stock rows.
+
+	The constructor takes no arguments; both extents are compiled capacities and no record may
+	reconfigure them. A freshly constructed image is the exact cold clear state, which differs
+	from a created live habitat: every column is zero except the four reference and identity
+	columns, which carry -1.
+	"""
+	var habitat_present: PackedByteArray = PackedByteArray()
+	var stock_present: PackedByteArray = PackedByteArray()
+	var habitat_type: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var habitat_zone_slot: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var habitat_zone_generation: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var habitat_effort_slots: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var habitat_pollution: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var habitat_danger: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var habitat_protected_fraction: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var habitat_capacity_milli: PackedInt64Array = PackedInt64Array()
+	var habitat_ref_slot: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var habitat_ref_generation: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var habitat_effort_used: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var habitat_intensive: PackedByteArray = PackedByteArray()
+	var stock_habitat_slot: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var stock_habitat_generation: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var stock_species_id: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
+	var stock_population_milli: PackedInt64Array = PackedInt64Array()
+	var stock_capacity_milli: PackedInt64Array = PackedInt64Array()
+	var stock_harvested_today_milli: PackedInt64Array = PackedInt64Array()
+	var stock_closed: PackedByteArray = PackedByteArray()
+	var stock_restocking: PackedByteArray = PackedByteArray()
+
+	func _init() -> void:
+		"""Size all 22 columns and fill each with its cold clear default."""
+		_size_habitat_columns()
+		_size_stock_columns()
+
+	func _size_habitat_columns() -> void:
+		"""Size and blank the 13 habitat columns at 32 rows."""
+		habitat_present.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_type.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_zone_slot.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_zone_generation.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_effort_slots.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_pollution.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_danger.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_protected_fraction.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_capacity_milli.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_ref_slot.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_ref_generation.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_effort_used.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_intensive.resize(FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY)
+		habitat_zone_slot.fill(CLAIM_COLUMN_BLANK_SLOT)
+		habitat_ref_slot.fill(CLAIM_COLUMN_BLANK_SLOT)
+
+	func _size_stock_columns() -> void:
+		"""Size and blank the 9 stock columns at 96 rows."""
+		stock_present.resize(FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY)
+		stock_habitat_slot.resize(FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY)
+		stock_habitat_generation.resize(FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY)
+		stock_species_id.resize(FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY)
+		stock_population_milli.resize(FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY)
+		stock_capacity_milli.resize(FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY)
+		stock_harvested_today_milli.resize(FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY)
+		stock_closed.resize(FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY)
+		stock_restocking.resize(FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY)
+		stock_habitat_slot.fill(CLAIM_COLUMN_BLANK_SLOT)
+		stock_species_id.fill(COLUMN_BLANK_SPECIES_ID)
+
+	func is_sized() -> bool:
+		"""True when all 22 columns carry their exact compiled extent."""
+		return _habitat_columns_sized() and _stock_columns_sized()
+
+	func _habitat_columns_sized() -> bool:
+		"""True when all 13 habitat columns are 32 cells."""
+		return habitat_present.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_type.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_zone_slot.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_zone_generation.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_effort_slots.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_pollution.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_danger.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_protected_fraction.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_capacity_milli.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_ref_slot.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_ref_generation.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_effort_used.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY \
+			and habitat_intensive.size() == FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY
+
+	func _stock_columns_sized() -> bool:
+		"""True when all 9 stock columns are 96 cells."""
+		return stock_present.size() == FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY \
+			and stock_habitat_slot.size() == FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY \
+			and stock_habitat_generation.size() == FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY \
+			and stock_species_id.size() == FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY \
+			and stock_population_milli.size() == FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY \
+			and stock_capacity_milli.size() == FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY \
+			and stock_harvested_today_milli.size() == FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY \
+			and stock_closed.size() == FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY \
+			and stock_restocking.size() == FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY
+
+
+static func columns_refusal(image: Columns) -> StringName:
+	"""The exact section 4 refusal code for one cold image, or REFUSE_NONE.
+
+	Argument-only and immutable: no live store, directory, catalog, callback, diagnostic, clock
+	or float is touched, and the image is never written. The gate order is the contract's:
+	shape, global flags, habitats, stocks, per-habitat species then quota, and finally the two
+	separate uniqueness scans.
+	"""
+	if image == null or not image.is_sized():
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_SHAPE
+	var code: StringName = _columns_flag_refusal(image)
+	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
+		return code
+	code = _columns_habitat_refusal(image)
+	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
+		return code
+	code = _columns_stock_refusal(image)
+	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
+		return code
+	code = _columns_species_quota_refusal(image)
+	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
+		return code
+	return _columns_duplicate_refusal(image)
+
+
+static func _columns_flag_refusal(image: Columns) -> StringName:
+	"""Every byte column in canonical field order, ascending physical rows within each."""
+	for slot: int in FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY:
+		if image.habitat_present[slot] > 1:
+			return REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAG
+	for row: int in FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY:
+		if image.stock_present[row] > 1:
+			return REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAG
+	for slot: int in FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY:
+		if image.habitat_intensive[slot] > 1:
+			return REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAG
+	for row: int in FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY:
+		if image.stock_closed[row] > 1:
+			return REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAG
+	for row: int in FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY:
+		if image.stock_restocking[row] > 1:
+			return REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAG
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_habitat_refusal(image: Columns) -> StringName:
+	"""Every habitat row in ascending order, first refusal winning."""
+	for slot: int in FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY:
+		var code: StringName = _columns_habitat_row_refusal(image, slot)
+		if code != REFUSE_NONE:
+			return code
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_habitat_row_refusal(image: Columns, slot: int) -> StringName:
+	"""One habitat row: enum, scalar domains, references, then free or present state."""
+	var habitat_type_id: int = image.habitat_type[slot]
+	if habitat_type_id < 0 or habitat_type_id >= HABITAT_TYPE_COUNT:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_ENUM
+	if image.habitat_pollution[slot] < 0 or image.habitat_protected_fraction[slot] < 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_VALUE
+	var danger: int = image.habitat_danger[slot]
+	if danger < DANGER_MIN or danger > DANGER_MAX:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_VALUE
+	var present: bool = image.habitat_present[slot] == 1
+	var code: StringName = _columns_habitat_ref_refusal(image, slot, present)
+	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
+		return code
+	if not present:
+		return _columns_habitat_free_refusal(image, slot, habitat_type_id)
+	return _columns_habitat_state_refusal(image, slot, habitat_type_id)
+
+
+static func _columns_habitat_ref_refusal(image: Columns, slot: int, present: bool) -> StringName:
+	"""Structural reference domains only: a stale but well-formed zone pair stays legal here."""
+	var self_slot: int = image.habitat_ref_slot[slot]
+	var self_generation: int = image.habitat_ref_generation[slot]
+	var zone_slot: int = image.habitat_zone_slot[slot]
+	var zone_generation: int = image.habitat_zone_generation[slot]
+	if not present:
+		if _columns_is_null_ref(self_slot, self_generation) \
+				and _columns_is_null_ref(zone_slot, zone_generation):
+			return REFUSE_NONE
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_REF
+	if not _columns_is_live_ref(self_slot, self_generation):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_REF
+	if _columns_is_null_ref(zone_slot, zone_generation):
+		return REFUSE_NONE
+	if not _columns_is_live_ref(zone_slot, zone_generation):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_REF
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_is_null_ref(slot: int, generation: int) -> bool:
+	"""True for the exact null reference (-1, 0)."""
+	return slot == CLAIM_COLUMN_BLANK_SLOT and generation == CLAIM_COLUMN_BLANK_GENERATION
+
+
+static func _columns_is_live_ref(slot: int, generation: int) -> bool:
+	"""True for a nonnull structural reference: slot in the directory domain, generation > 0."""
+	return slot >= 0 and slot <= CLAIM_COLUMN_DIRECTORY_SLOT_MAX \
+		and generation > CLAIM_COLUMN_BLANK_GENERATION
+
+
+static func _columns_habitat_free_refusal(image: Columns, slot: int,
+		habitat_type_id: int) -> StringName:
+	"""An inactive habitat keeps its retained scalars but holds no capacity, effort or policy."""
+	if image.habitat_capacity_milli[slot] != 0 or image.habitat_effort_used[slot] != 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_FREE
+	if image.habitat_intensive[slot] != 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_FREE
+	var slots: int = image.habitat_effort_slots[slot]
+	if slots != 0 and slots != EFFORT_SLOTS_BY_TYPE[habitat_type_id]:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_FREE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_habitat_state_refusal(image: Columns, slot: int,
+		habitat_type_id: int) -> StringName:
+	"""A present habitat's source-table effort capacity, occupancy range and summed capacity."""
+	var slots: int = image.habitat_effort_slots[slot]
+	if slots != EFFORT_SLOTS_BY_TYPE[habitat_type_id]:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_STATE
+	var used: int = image.habitat_effort_used[slot]
+	if used < 0 or used > slots:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_STATE
+	if image.habitat_capacity_milli[slot] != _capacity_milli_for_type(habitat_type_id):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_HABITAT_STATE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_stock_refusal(image: Columns) -> StringName:
+	"""Every stock row in ascending order, first refusal winning."""
+	for row: int in FISH_STOCK_CAPACITY:
+		var code: StringName = _columns_stock_row_refusal(image, row)
+		if code != REFUSE_NONE:
+			return code
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_stock_row_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""One stock row against its owning habitat row/3 and species position row%3."""
+	var parent: int = row / SPECIES_PER_HABITAT
+	if image.stock_present[row] != image.habitat_present[parent]:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_LINK
+	if image.stock_present[row] != 1:
+		return _columns_stock_free_refusal(image, row)
+	if image.stock_habitat_slot[row] != image.habitat_ref_slot[parent] \
+			or image.stock_habitat_generation[row] != image.habitat_ref_generation[parent]:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_LINK
+	if image.stock_species_id[row] < 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_SPECIES
+	var code: StringName = _columns_stock_value_refusal(image, row, parent)
+	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
+		return code
+	return _columns_stock_state_refusal(image, row)
+
+
+static func _columns_stock_free_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""An inactive stock row is entirely blank: no retained history of any kind."""
+	if not _columns_is_null_ref(image.stock_habitat_slot[row],
+			image.stock_habitat_generation[row]):
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_FREE
+	if image.stock_species_id[row] != COLUMN_BLANK_SPECIES_ID:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_FREE
+	if image.stock_population_milli[row] != 0 or image.stock_capacity_milli[row] != 0 \
+			or image.stock_harvested_today_milli[row] != 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_FREE
+	if image.stock_closed[row] != 0 or image.stock_restocking[row] != 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_FREE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_stock_value_refusal(image: Columns, row: int, parent: int) -> StringName:
+	"""Source capacity, the 10%..K population band and the quota-bounded daily harvest.
+
+	The species is the compiled table row for this habitat type and position, never the stored
+	item id, which is an arbitrary nonnegative i32 and subscripts nothing.
+	"""
+	var species: int = HABITAT_SPECIES_ROWS[image.habitat_type[parent] * SPECIES_PER_HABITAT
+		+ row % SPECIES_PER_HABITAT]
+	var capacity: int = SPECIES_CAPACITY_U[species] * MILLI_PER_UNIT
+	if image.stock_capacity_milli[row] != capacity:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_VALUE
+	var population: int = image.stock_population_milli[row]
+	if population < _percent_of(capacity, HARD_FLOOR_PERCENT) or population > capacity:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_VALUE
+	var harvested: int = image.stock_harvested_today_milli[row]
+	if harvested < 0 or harvested > image.habitat_capacity_milli[parent] / DAILY_QUOTA_DIVISOR:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_VALUE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_stock_state_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
+	"""Strict 30-down/40-up hysteresis by cross multiplication; the 30..40 band accepts either.
+
+	`closed` is an independent stored boolean and is deliberately not derived here.
+	"""
+	var scaled_population: int = PERCENT_DENOMINATOR * image.stock_population_milli[row]
+	var capacity: int = image.stock_capacity_milli[row]
+	var restocking: int = image.stock_restocking[row]
+	if scaled_population < DEPLETION_WARNING_PERCENT * capacity and restocking != 1:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_STATE
+	if scaled_population > RESTOCK_RECOVERY_PERCENT * capacity and restocking != 0:
+		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STOCK_STATE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_species_quota_refusal(image: Columns) -> StringName:
+	"""Per present habitat in ascending order: distinct item ids, then the shared daily quota.
+
+	Every single-stock value was bounded above, so the three-term sum is safe.
+	"""
+	for slot: int in FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY:
+		if image.habitat_present[slot] != 1:
+			continue
+		var base: int = slot * SPECIES_PER_HABITAT
+		for position: int in SPECIES_PER_HABITAT:
+			for other: int in position:
+				if image.stock_species_id[base + other] \
+						== image.stock_species_id[base + position]:
+					return REFUSE_COLUMN_SPECIES_DUPLICATE
+		var taken: int = 0
+		for index: int in SPECIES_PER_HABITAT:
+			taken += image.stock_harvested_today_milli[base + index]
+		if taken > image.habitat_capacity_milli[slot] / DAILY_QUOTA_DIVISOR:
+			return REFUSE_COLUMN_QUOTA
+	return REFUSE_NONE
+
+
+static func _columns_duplicate_refusal(image: Columns) -> StringName:
+	"""Self SLOT uniqueness first, then a SEPARATE nonnull zone SLOT+GENERATION pair scan.
+
+	Two zone generations sharing one slot are accepted; two current self generations sharing
+	one slot are refused. Both scans are fixed 32-row and allocate no packed scratch.
+	"""
+	for slot: int in FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY:
+		if image.habitat_present[slot] != 1:
+			continue
+		for other: int in slot:
+			if image.habitat_present[other] == 1 \
+					and image.habitat_ref_slot[other] == image.habitat_ref_slot[slot]:
+				return REFUSE_COLUMN_SELF_DUPLICATE
+	for zone_row: int in FISH_HABITAT_CAPACITY:
+		if image.habitat_present[zone_row] != 1:
+			continue
+		if _columns_is_null_ref(image.habitat_zone_slot[zone_row],
+				image.habitat_zone_generation[zone_row]):
+			continue
+		for zone_other: int in zone_row:
+			if image.habitat_present[zone_other] != 1:
+				continue
+			if image.habitat_zone_slot[zone_other] == image.habitat_zone_slot[zone_row] \
+					and image.habitat_zone_generation[zone_other] \
+					== image.habitat_zone_generation[zone_row]:
+				return REFUSE_COLUMN_ZONE_DUPLICATE
+	return REFUSE_NONE
